summary.text: Patty Bradway is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 36B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Brion Curran (D).
She was also the Republican nominee for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Patty Bradway ran for Minnesota House District 36B in 2024 and lost the November 5, 2024 general election to incumbent Brion Curran, who received 51.6 percent of the vote.
